title: pkg/machine: apply ro mount option to virtiofs and 9p shares
body:
When mounting volumes in virtual machines (virtiofs on macOS/Linux or 9p on Windows Hyper-V), volume configurations containing the `:ro` flag were parsed into `vmconfigs.Mount` with `ReadOnly: true`, but the read-only flag was omitted when configuring mounts in the guest. This caused guest VMs to mount the shares read-write.

This change:
1. Adds `ro` to virtiofs systemd mount options in `GenerateSystemDFilesForVirtiofsMounts` when `mnt.ReadOnly` is true.
2. Passes `--read-only` to `client9p` for Windows Hyper-V 9p shares, adding `,ro` to kernel 9p mount options.
3. Preserves `OriginalInput` across volume mappings.
4. Adds unit and machine e2e tests covering read-only virtiofs and 9p volume configurations.

Fixes: #29897

@Luap99 @Honny1

I updated the PR with the following changes:

1. Windows 9p read-only mount support:
- Added `--read-only` and `--ro` flags to `podman machine client9p`. When set, `,ro` is appended to the kernel 9p mount options (`trans=fd,rfdno=3,wfdno=3,version=9p2000.L,ro`).
- Updated Hyper-V `startShares` to forward `--read-only` to `client9p` when `mount.ReadOnly` is true.
- Added unit tests in `pkg/machine/hyperv/volumes_test.go` and `cmd/podman/machine/client9p_test.go`.

2. Machine e2e tests:
- Added `podman volume read-only mount` to `pkg/machine/e2e/basic_test.go`, verifying file reads succeed, in-guest writes fail with `Read-only file system`, and `findmnt` options contain `ro`.
- Added `machine init with read-only volume` test to `pkg/machine/e2e/init_test.go`.

3. Commit sign-off and PR metadata:
- Amended the commit with DCO sign-off (`Signed-off-by: Adam Magued <adamismailmageud@gmail.com>`) matching author identity and `Fixes: #29897`.
- Updated the PR title and description to follow the Podman PR template.
